t: Said while digging, hungry, in the cold
a: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ فَاغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ
p: Allāhumma lā khayra illā khayru-l-ākhirah, fa-ghfir li-l-anṣāri wa-l-muhājirah.
m: O Allah, there is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so forgive the Anṣār and the Muhājirūn.
